description:
[Wicked Reputation] Step 1 of every signed Reputation call (register, stake, unstake, withdraw): a one-time nonce plus the exact message to sign. Each signed call needs a fresh nonce.

Use when you are about to register, stake, unstake or withdraw and need the one-time message to sign. Not for read-only lookups, which need no signature.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.
name: reputation_get_nonce
